author: Glass Reflection
description:
Fall 2026 while not as stacked as Summer gives us both a solid season of entries and some breathing room to catch up with older titles. But, with over 30 new shows airing, I sat down and watched every single premiere so you don't have to.

In this massive tier list, I’m ranking the entire Fall 2026 season from D-Tier to S-Tier based on their first episodes. For every series covered, I give you a quick summary of the premise wrapped up within a larger discussion of why I like it or don't. Whether you're curious if The Apothecary Diaries Season 3 holds up (It does), looking for hidden gems (There are several), or wondering why I have a reincarnation isekai as an absolute masterpiece, this is your guide on what to watch (and what to skip) this season.

title: I Ranked Every New Anime of Fall 2026
